card.name: Inside long medical words
card.fires_on: Pieces partway through long medical words split into several parts, such as ADOLE-SC-ENTS, susceptible, antimalarials and malariologist. It fires on the middle piece, not the start or end.

modes.label: Capitalised warning word
modes.description: The middle piece of ADOLESCENTS in the boxed suicidality warning heading.
modes.example: WARNING: SUICIDAL IDEATION IN CHILDREN AND ADOLE<<SC>>ENTS Atomoxetine increased the risk of suicidal

modes.label: Drug or disease class words
modes.description: A middle piece of words like susceptible or antimalarials.
modes.example: onsus<<cept>>ible Organisms The use of Clind

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Middle pieces of ordinary words such as legislature or backache.
modes.example: irritability, anxiety, back<<ache>>, joint pain, weakness, abdominal cr

card.plain: It marks the middle of a long, split-up medical word, where the word is not yet finished.
